regime_state_definition.computation: Per current structural representative, compute a strictly causal trailing ATR(14)-on-M5 percentile rank over a fixed trailing lookback window (no future bars, no whole-sample normalization), refreshed bar-by-bar, using only already-captured 13W M5 history.
regime_state_definition.leakage_controls: Regime label at bar t depends only on bars <= t-1; classification thresholds fixed ex ante from the trailing window, not from the evaluation window; no outcome-derived thresholding.

objective.goal: Specify the exact regime-state definition, conditioning law, and frontier-relative breadth for the next legal non-economic prospective research wave, following the fail-closed CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE boundary and the deterministic closure of the 41/41 current-representative 13W-history gap.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The opportunity map and information-gain selection show all cross-family deterministic shared gaps (structural signature, current margin, 13W history, breakout-event availability) are closed at 41/41. CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE is fail-closed because no authoritative term-structure/maturity metadata exists in repository evidence and none may be synthesized. REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED was already flagged as the secondary priority with sufficient existing causal history to define semantics without another broad capture. Conditioning an already non-economically screened breakout-follow-through edge on a strictly causal (no-lookahead) trailing volatility regime maximizes information gain per unit of new deterministic work: it reuses existing 13W M5 captures and existing breakout event/follow-through/persistence structural evidence, and asks only the one remaining scientific question (what regime law conditions the edge) that a deterministic selector cannot answer on its own.
